jingle.line: To me, they still seem to jingle
stanza: Are you comfortable with these words?
To me, they still seem to jingle
Like the pair of a bad man’s spurs

single.line: Truthfully, between you and me, I'm usually single
single.linePrev: Take the whip, two pills on the lips on the wheel (For real, for real)
single.lineNext: When it's hot outside this, I ride through any hood with the top out

single.line: If you took all the girls I knew when I was single
stanza: If you took all the girls I knew when I was single
And brought 'em all together for one night
I know they'd never match my sweet imagination
And everything looks worse in black and white
